# Hapn

> Hapn is a campus discovery and community platform. It helps students discover college events and fests, share useful campus requests through Hapn Connect, and take part in anonymous campus conversations.

## What Hapn offers

- College event discovery: workshops, hackathons, competitions, cultural programmes, sports and other campus activities.
- College fests: discover fest information, schedules and related activities published on Hapn.
- Hapn Connect (Share N Care): a campus community board for relevant student requests and updates, such as rides, lost and found, finding teammates and campus help. Public overview: [Hapn Connect](https://hapn.info/hapn-connect/). Community feed access may require sign-in and college eligibility; private or account-only posts are not public search content.
- Hapn Anonymous Chat: campus conversations through available experiences such as Campus Lounge, Group Chat and Ask the Community.
- Event submission: organisers can submit event information for review. Submission does not mean automatic publication.

## Important accuracy notes

- Event details, schedules, venues and registration links may be supplied by organisers and can change. Users should verify important details with the organiser.
- Hapn is a discovery and community platform; it is not automatically the organiser, ticket seller or registration authority for listed events.
- Hapn Connect is intended for campus-related requests and updates. Users should avoid publishing private contact details or sensitive personal information.
- Anonymous Chat uses an anonymous display experience; this does not guarantee complete or permanent anonymity or end-to-end encryption.
- Some community experiences may require an eligible college account. Access and feature availability can vary.
